scripts.test:api: npm run collection:generate && node postman/tools/run-newman.js --folder "00 Health" --folder "01 CRUD Lifecycle" --folder "02 Validation (Negative)" --folder "03 Uniqueness" --folder "04 Errors and Routing" -r cli,htmlextra,junit --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/api/api-report.html --reporter-junit-export reports/api/api-junit.xml
scripts.test:data: node postman/tools/run-newman.js --folder "05 Data-Driven" --iteration-data postman/test-data.csv -r cli,htmlextra,junit --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/api/data-report.html --reporter-junit-export reports/api/data-junit.xml
scripts.test:all: npm run test:api && npm run test:data && npm run test:reset-disabled
